author: Nintendo of America
description:
Stellar Blade Complete Edition is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on November 5, 2026! Pre-order today: https://ninten.do/6003ak7YH 

Dress up EVE and reclaim Earth in style with four brand-new couture outfits inspired by Bayonetta!  

EVE is a member of the 7th Airborne Squad sent to reclaim an Earth devastated by mysterious, powerful creatures known as the Naytiba. In Stellar Blade Complete Edition, you'll engage in razor-sharp, stylish combat as you explore breathtaking post-apocalyptic landscapes, face intense boss encounters, and uncover the dark truths behind humanity’s fall. 

Optimized for Nintendo Switch 2, experience EVE’s journey at home or on the go, complete with immersive Joy-Con 2 motion controls for activities like fishing. 

#StellarBlade
